title: REEL: Learning to Retrieve, Evaluate, and Evolve Visual Memory for Any Long-Horizon Multi-Shot Video Generation
title_zh: REEL：学习检索、评估与演化视觉记忆，以实现任意长时程多镜头视频生成

paragraphs.en: Memory-based long-video generation aims to combine user control with long-range visual consistency. We organize this process into three functional components: a planner, an adapter, and a generator. Representative multi-shot systems couple memory to generator-specific interfaces or use predefined agent workflows, rather than independently training a memory policy for cross-shot objectives. We introduce REEL, a general-purpose visual-memory planner. Through a unified tool interface, REEL learns to retrieve references, create missing visual evidence, and update persistent memory. Backend-specific adapters translate its evidence plans into supported conditioning inputs, allowing the same policy to guide different black-box video generators. To train REEL, we construct two high-quality datasets, REEL-SFT-4k and REEL-RL-1k, covering diverse interaction patterns and prompt types. Training proceeds in three stages: supervised fine-tuning, single-shot Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and multi-shot GRPO. Multi-shot GRPO carries policy-generated memory across consecutive shots, so later outcomes guide earlier reference selection and memory updates. REEL-Bench tests identity preservation and intended state changes under text-only requests and timed reference-image uploads. On JoyAI-Echo 1.5 and MiniMax-H3, REEL improves cross-shot consistency on ST-Bench by 15.1% and 20.7%, and Core-100 on our proposed REEL-Bench by 2.41 and 8.32 points, respectively, over the no-memory baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 基于记忆的长度视频生成旨在结合用户控制与长时程视觉一致性。 我们将这一过程组织为三个功能组件：一个规划器、一个适配器和一个生成器。 典型的多次拍摄系统将记忆与生成器特定的接口耦合，或使用预定义的智能体工作流程，而非独立训练用于跨拍摄目标的记忆策略。 我们提出了 REEL，一种通用型视觉记忆规划器。 通过统一的工具接口，REEL 能够学习检索参考信息、创建缺失的视觉证据，并更新持久性记忆。 针对特定后端系统的适配器会将其证据计划转换为支持的条件输入，从而让同一策略指导不同的黑箱视频生成器。 为了训练 REEL，我们构建了两个高质量数据集：REEL-SFT-4k 和 REEL-RL-1k，涵盖了多样的交互模式和提示类型。 训练分为三个阶段：监督微调、单次拍摄的组相对策略优化（GRPO），以及多次拍摄的 GRPO。 多次拍摄 GRPO 会将策略生成的记忆贯穿连续拍摄，因此后续结果会指导早期的参考信息选择和记忆更新。 REEL-Bench 在仅通过文本请求和定时上传参考图像的情况下，测试了身份保持与预期状态变化的能力。 在 JoyAI-Echo 1.5 和 MiniMax-H3 上，与无记忆基线相比，REEL 在 ST-Bench 上的跨拍摄一致性分别提升了 15.1% 和 20.7%，在我们提出的 REEL-Bench 的 Core-100 指标上分别提升了 2.41 分和 8.32 分。

paragraphs.en: Multi-shot video generation typically turn shot descriptions into a coherent story while keeping recurring characters, objects, and locations recognizable ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . The preceding clip may lack the evidence required when an entity returns after a long gap. Historical references also accommodates narrative changes, such as a new costume or an altered object state. The key challenge is therefore to select evidence that preserves identity while following the current request , and to retain observations useful for future shots.
paragraphs.zh: 多镜头视频生成通常将镜头描述转化为连贯的故事，同时保持重复出现的角色、物体和场景具有可识别性（Zhang 等人，2025）。 当某个实体在长时间缺席后重新出现时，前面的片段可能缺乏所需的证据。 历史参考同样可以容纳叙事变化，例如新的服装或物体状态的改变。 因此，关键挑战在于选择既能保留身份特征又能满足当前需求的证据，并保留对未来镜头有用的观察信息。

paragraphs.en: Multi-shot video generation involves a planner for shot content and visual context, a backend adapter for model-specific conditioning, and a generator for synthesis. StoryMem embeds keyframe memory in its diffusion backbone, requiring memory-interface adaptation across backbones ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . CoTriSyGen coordinates prompt refinement and entity-memory updates through VLM feedback ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , while DirectorAgent uses a prompt-driven workflow for planning, reference selection, output review, and memory admission ( Duan et al., 2026 ) . These agent workflows base memory decisions primarily on predefined procedures and general-purpose model inference, rather than a visual-memory policy independently trained for cross-shot generation objectives .
paragraphs.zh: 多镜头视频生成涉及一个用于规划镜头内容和视觉上下文的规划器、一个用于模型特定条件输入的后台适配器，以及一个用于合成的生成器。 StoryMem 在其扩散模型主干中嵌入关键帧记忆，这需要在不同主干之间进行记忆接口适配（Zhang 等人，2025）。 CoTriSyGen 通过视觉语言模型反馈协调提示词优化与实体记忆更新（Yin 等人，2026），而 DirectorAgent 则采用以提示词驱动的工作流进行规划、参考选择、输出审查和记忆接纳（Duan 等人，2026）。 这些智能体工作流主要基于预定义流程和通用模型推理来做出记忆决策，而非采用为跨镜头生成目标独立训练的视觉记忆策略。

paragraphs.en: We introduce REEL, a learnable visual-memory planner . Its backend-independent tool interface exposes uploaded references, a memory bank, and a subject-linked material registry. From requests and tool observations, REEL chooses tools and arguments to retrieve and inspect evidence, create missing references, review candidates, and maintain memory. It submits an evidence plan with an enhanced prompt and ranked references with explicit roles. An adapter maps the plan to supported inputs for a fixed, black-box generator; candidate feedback guides subsequent tool calls. New backends reuse the same planner and tool protocol through backend-specific adapters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 REEL，一种可学习的视觉记忆规划器。 其独立于后端工具接口提供了上传的参考材料、一个记忆库以及一个与主题关联的材料注册表。 基于请求和工具观察结果，REEL 会选择工具和参数来检索并检查证据、创建缺失的参考材料、审查候选项以及维护记忆。 它会提交一个包含增强提示词和带有明确角色的排序参考材料的证据计划。 一个适配器将该计划映射到固定黑箱生成器所支持的输入；候选反馈会指导后续的工具调用。 新的后端可以通过特定于后端的适配器重复使用相同的规划器和工具协议。

sents.en: We introduce REEL, a learnable visual-memory planner .
sents.zh: 我们提出 REEL，一种可学习的视觉记忆规划器。

paragraphs.en: To support REEL training, we construct REEL-SFT-4k and REEL-RL-1k from diverse multi-shot requests and VLM-teacher interactions with real image and video generation services (see Figure 4 ). Our data engine filters demonstrations for execution validity and media provenance, and packages requests with initial resource states for RL. We also introduce REEL-Bench, comprising 300 stories and 2,700 shots across diverse visual styles and interaction patterns. Text-only requests and simulated image uploads before or during a story test identity preservation and intended state changes.
paragraphs.zh: 为支持 REEL 训练，我们从多样化的多轮请求以及与真实图像和视频生成服务的 VLM-教师模型交互中构建 REEL-SFT-4k 和 REEL-RL-1k（参见图 4）。 我们的数据引擎会筛选演示案例的执行有效性和媒体来源，并为强化学习打包包含初始资源状态的请求。 我们还引入了 REEL-Bench，它包含 300 个故事和 2,700 个镜头，涵盖多样化的视觉风格和交互模式。 纯文本请求以及在故事测试前后或测试过程中模拟的图像上传，用于验证身份保留性和预期的状态变化。

paragraphs.en: REEL learns through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), single-shot Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , and multi-shot GRPO. SFT initializes tool use from teacher demonstrations; single-shot GRPO refines reference selection, condition assessment, and memory updates within one shot. Yet memory’s value extends beyond that shot: a retained reference may support an entity’s later return, while an outdated state may misguide subsequent generation. Multi-shot GRPO therefore optimizes consecutive requests while carrying forward memory produced by the policy, allowing later outcomes to shape earlier reference and writeback decisions .
paragraphs.zh: REEL 通过监督微调（SFT）、单样本组相对策略优化（GRPO）（Shao 等人，2024）以及多样本 GRPO 进行学习。 SFT 从教师的演示中初始化工具使用；单样本 GRPO 则在一次样本处理中优化参考选择、条件评估和记忆更新。 然而，记忆的价值并不仅限于该次样本：保留的参考可能支持实体后续的返回，而过时的状态则可能误导后续生成。 因此，多样本 GRPO 在优化连续请求的同时，会携带策略生成的记忆，使后续结果能够影响早期的参考和回写决策。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate REEL on REEL-Bench and StoryMem ST-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) with JoyAI-Echo 1.5 and MiniMax-H3. On REEL-Bench, REEL achieves the highest Core-100, state compliance, and narrative coherence among the compared methods on both backends. On ST-Bench, it achieves the highest overall and top-10 cross-shot consistency. Ablations show that retrieval, reference creation, and candidate review each improve story-level quality, with the largest drop occurring when historical retrieval is removed. The same frozen planner also transfers to four unseen video backends through adapters, without target-backend fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 JoyAI-Echo 1.5 和 MiniMax-H3，在 REEL-Bench 和 StoryMem ST-Bench（Zhang 等人，2025）上对 REEL 进行了评估。 在 REEL-Bench 上，与所比较的方法相比，REEL 在这两种后端上都实现了最高的 Core-100、状态一致性和叙事连贯性。 在 ST-Bench 上，它实现了最高的整体一致性和前 10 名跨镜头一致性。 消融实验表明，检索、参考创建和候选者审查各自都能提升故事层面的质量，其中移除历史检索时质量下降最为显著。 同一套冻结规划器通过适配器也能迁移到四个未见的视频后端，而无需针对目标后端进行微调。

paragraphs.en: We propose REEL , the first general-purpose, trainable visual-memory planner for multi-shot video generation, with a backend-independent tool interface for learning memory decisions within a three-stage’s training across video generators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 REEL，这是首个通用且可训练的视觉记忆规划器，专为多镜头视频生成而设计。它具备一个与后端无关的工具接口，支持在三阶段训练流程中，于不同的视频生成器之间学习记忆决策。

paragraphs.en: We construct REEL-SFT-4k, REEL-RL-1k, and REEL-Bench for learning and evaluating visual-memory planning under evolving requests and reference uploads.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 REEL-SFT-4k、REEL-RL-1k 和 REEL-Bench，用于在请求和参考上传不断变化的情况下，学习并评估视觉记忆规划能力。

paragraphs.en: With JoyAI-Echo 1.5 and MiniMax-H3, the full REEL planner improves Core-100 on REEL-Bench by 1.21 and 4.25 points over DirectorAgent, respectively. It also improves cross-shot consistency on ST-Bench by 15.1% and 20.7% over No Generated Memory.

paragraphs.en: Long-video models extend temporal context through hierarchical prediction, cascaded diffusion, or joint denoising ( Villegas et al., 2022 ; Yin et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . Training-free methods reuse pretrained models with correlated noise, temporal windows, denoising queues, or frequency-aware attention ( Qiu et al., 2024 ; Henschel et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ) . Self-forcing aligns autoregressive training with model-generated histories ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . These methods continue a temporal stream; REEL learns to select evidence across independently generated, editable shots when entities return beyond recent context (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 长视频模型通过分层预测、级联扩散或联合去噪来扩展时间上下文（Villegas 等，2022；Yin 等，2023；Wang 等，2023）。 无需训练的方法会复用预训练模型，并利用相关噪声、时间窗口、去噪队列或频率感知注意力机制（Qiu 等，2024；Henschel 等，2025；Kim 等，2024；Lu 等，2024）。 自强化方法将自回归训练与模型生成的历史信息对齐（Huang 等，2025）。 这些方法延续了时间流；当实体在近期上下文之外再次出现时，REEL 能够学会在独立生成且可编辑的镜头中选择证据（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: Reference-conditioned models preserve subjects from images ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) , while story-generation methods extend appearance consistency across images or clips ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Generator-internal memory preserves appearance through latent retrieval ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , learned subject representations ( Wei et al., 2026b ) , or feature storage and routing ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . At the shot interface, methods organize reference evidence by entity ( Vandersanden et al., 2026 ) or audio-visual slot ( Huang et al., 2026a ) , or condition generation with routed references and anchors ( Huang et al., 2026b ) or context clips ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . JoyAI-Echo 1.5 accepts composable cross-shot audio-visual memories ( Duan et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 参考条件模型能够保留图像中的主体（Jiang 等，2023；He 等，2024；Yuan 等，2025），而故事生成方法则能在不同图像或片段中保持外观的一致性（Zhou 等，2024；Zhao 等，2025）。 生成器内部的记忆机制通过潜在空间检索（Hu 等，2026）、学习到的主体表示（Wei 等，2026b），或特征存储与路由（Liu 等，2026b；Ding 等，2026；Xu 等，2026）来保持外观的一致性。 在单帧接口层面，相关方法按实体组织参考证据（Vandersanden 等，2026），或按视听槽位进行组织（Huang 等，2026a），亦可通过路由的参考信息和锚点（Huang 等，2026b）或上下文片段（Guo 等，2026）对生成过程施加条件。 JoyAI-Echo 1.5 支持可组合的跨帧视听记忆（Duan 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Among the closest systems, GroundShot builds verified entity memory, retrieves references, and schedules shots by reference utility ( Lai et al., 2026 ) , while CoTriSyGen updates prompts and entity memory through VLM analysis ( Yin et al., 2026 ) . Both use task-specific orchestration procedures around pretrained generators. REEL learns a visual-memory policy through a backend-independent tool interface and delegates generator-specific conditioning to adapters.
paragraphs.zh: 在同类最接近的系统中，GroundShot 构建经过验证的实体记忆、检索引用信息，并根据引用的效用安排拍摄（Lai 等，2026），而 CoTriSyGen 则通过 VLM 分析更新提示和实体记忆（Yin 等，2026）。 两者都围绕预训练生成器采用任务特定的协调流程。 REEL 通过一个与后端无关的工具接口学习视觉-记忆策略，并将生成器特定的条件设置委托给适配器。

paragraphs.en: Tool-using models interleave reasoning and actions ( Yao et al., 2023 ) and acquire tool-use patterns ( Schick et al., 2023 ) . Persistent memory adds storage, retrieval, and updates ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . Memory-R1 learns memory management through outcome-driven RL ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , while Mem-T addresses delayed credit assignment ( Yue et al., 2026 ) . V-Mem routes retrieval across image–text histories, and WorldMemArena evaluates multimodal memory stages ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . VideoWeaver evolves reusable generation skills through process and outcome feedback ( Wei et al., 2026a ) . REEL couples memory decisions to the visual outcomes of a stochastic generator, where stored evidence can benefit or mislead multiple later shots.
paragraphs.zh: 使用工具模型将推理与行动交替进行（Yao 等，2023），并习得工具使用模式（Schick 等，2023）。 持久化内存增加了存储、检索和更新功能（Packer 等，2024；Xu 等，2025）。 Memory-R1 通过结果驱动的强化学习学习内存管理（Yan 等，2026），而 Mem-T 则解决延迟信用分配问题（Yue 等，2026）。 V-Mem 可在图像与文本历史之间路由检索，WorldMemArena 则评估多模态记忆的阶段（Kang 等，2026；Liu 等，2026a）。 VideoWeaver 通过过程与结果反馈演化可重复使用的生成技能（Wei 等，2026a）。 REEL 将内存决策与随机生成器的视觉结果相耦合，其中存储的证据可能有助于或误导后续多次尝试。

paragraphs.en: The policy chooses tool calls and arguments from the current request and observations. Its actions support evidence retrieval and inspection, reference creation, plan submission, candidate assessment, and memory maintenance; Appendix A.3 lists the nine tools. Retrieval, creation, revision, and writeback are conditional decisions, not a fixed execution sequence. The planner may use uploads directly, discard unsuitable references, or create missing ones before submitting an evidence plan. Candidate assessment follows the runtime checklist for reference suitability, request and condition adherence, and observable visual defects. Permitted retries follow the runtime’s repair or resampling contract and remaining budget (Appendix A.3 ). Writeback separately assesses the stability and future usefulness of evidence from the selected final clip: the planner can commit supported bank and registry updates together or finish without writing.
paragraphs.zh: 策略从当前请求和观察结果中选择工具调用及其参数。 其操作支持证据检索与检查、参考创建、计划提交、候选评估和记忆维护；附录 A.3 列出了九种工具。 检索、创建、修订和回写均为条件性决策，而非固定的执行顺序。 规划器可以直接使用上传内容，丢弃不合适的参考，或在提交证据计划前创建缺失的参考。 候选评估遵循运行时检查清单，涵盖参考的适用性、对请求和条件的遵守情况，以及可观察的视觉缺陷。 允许的重试遵循运行时的修复或重新采样协议以及剩余预算（附录 A.3）。 回写会单独评估所选最终片段中证据的稳定性和未来效用：规划器可以一并提交经支持的数据库和注册表更新，也可以在不执行写入操作的情况下结束流程。

A teacher then executes the planner’s tools with real image and video generation, carrying memory across shots. We remove malformed requests and incomplete trajectories and check tool-call correspondence, legal state transitions, and media provenance. The retained action–observation trajectories form REEL-SFT-4k, 𝒟 SFT \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{SFT}} , excluding teacher reasoning and adapter-internal content. REEL-RL-1k supplies requests and initial resource states for single-shot tasks and contiguous multi-shot episodes. Online rollouts use policy actions and accumulated memory without resetting to teacher states.
paragraphs.zh: 一种 VLM 会在不同场景、风格、长度和记忆依赖关系之间扩展初始故事，同时保留其核心主题（图 4）。 随后，教师智能体使用真实的图像和视频生成功能执行规划器的工具，并在不同镜头间传递记忆。 我们移除格式错误的请求和不完整的轨迹，并检查工具调用的对应性、合法的状态转换以及媒体来源。 保留下来的动作-观察轨迹构成了 REEL-SFT-4k（𝒟 SFT \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{SFT}}），其中排除了教师的推理过程和适配器内部的内容。 REEL-RL-1k 为单镜头任务和连续的多镜头情节提供请求和初始资源状态。 在线展开过程使用策略动作和累积的记忆，而不会重置到教师智能体的状态。

paragraphs.en: REEL-Bench contains 300 stories and 2,700 shots selected from 12,000 source stories, balancing visual styles and upload configurations across diverse subjects and sequence lengths. It includes text-only episodes and simulated reference-image uploads before or during a story, covering entity reappearances, scene changes, and explicit appearance or object-state transitions. We preserve complete shot sequences, requests, assets, and upload timing, excluding missing inputs and duplicate request sequences. All methods receive identical requests and scheduled uploads, cannot access future uploads, and maintain memory from their own generated outputs. The fixed benchmark tests identity preservation and adherence to evolving instructions through shot- and story-level visual evaluation by Gemini 3.5 Flash. Judge and sampling details appear in Appendix C.3 , with Core-100 aggregation defined in Appendix D . The benchmark shares no exact story identifiers with the SFT training split; we also performed content-level deduplication of stories and references against the training data (Appendix C.1 ). Human visual inspection found qualitative agreement with the judge.
paragraphs.zh: REEL-Bench 包含 300 个故事和 2,700 个镜头，这些内容是从 12,000 个源故事中挑选出来的，在多样化的主题和序列长度中平衡了视觉风格和上传配置。 它包括纯文本剧集，以及在故事开始之前或进行过程中模拟的参考图像上传，涵盖了实体的再次出现、场景变化，以及明确的外观或物体状态转换。 我们保留了完整的镜头序列、请求、资产和上传时间，但排除了缺失的输入和重复的请求序列。 所有方法都接收到相同的请求和计划好的上传，无法访问未来的上传内容，并且能够保留自身生成输出中的记忆。 该固定基准测试通过 Gemini 3.5 Flash 对镜头和故事级别的视觉表现进行评估，以检验身份保持能力以及对不断变化的指令的遵循程度。 评分标准和采样细节见附录 C.3，Core-100 的聚合方法定义在附录 D 中。 该基准测试与 SFT 训练数据集中的故事没有完全相同的标识符；此外，我们还对故事和参考内容进行了内容层面的去重处理（附录 C.1）。 通过人工视觉检查发现，其定性结果与评分标准一致。

paragraphs.en: REEL uses Qwen3.5-9B, trained with SFT on REEL-SFT-4k and single-shot and multi-shot GRPO on REEL-RL-1k. JoyAI-Echo 1.5 and MiniMax-H3 jointly provide the planner’s RL rollouts. In the quantitative tables, REEL denotes the full jointly trained checkpoint after all three stages; training-stage variants are identified separately. paragraphs.en: We compare No Generated Memory (available user references only), Recent Memory (FIFO), CLIP-based Retrieval, StoryMem-style Memory, and DirectorAgent. The three heuristic memory policies respectively select recent keyframes, request-relevant frames, or protected early frames supplemented by recent ones, using shared aesthetic filtering and diversity selection. StoryMem-style adapts memory selection, not its original generator ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) ; DirectorAgent’s JoyAI-Echo 1.5 workflow also runs on MiniMax-H3 ( Duan et al., 2026 ) . Comparisons match requests, uploads, generation settings, and first-attempt seeds within each backend, allowing up to two video candidates and one condition-plan revision per shot. Each method accesses only its own generated history and currently available uploads; memory resets between stories. Call counts include failed attempts, and completion uses all requested shots. Appendix E details the baselines, budget scopes, and cost accounting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了“无生成记忆”（仅使用可用用户参考）、“近期记忆”（先进先出队列）、基于 CLIP 的检索、StoryMem 风格记忆以及 DirectorAgent。 三种启发式记忆策略分别选择近期关键帧、与请求相关的帧，或使用共享的美学过滤和多样性选择机制，在受保护早期帧的基础上补充近期帧。 StoryMem 风格方法调整的是记忆选择机制，而非其原始生成器（Zhang 等，2025）；DirectorAgent 的 JoyAI-Echo 1.5 工作流程也运行于 MiniMax-H3（Duan 等，2026）。 各比较实验在相同后端环境中匹配请求、上传内容、生成设置及首次尝试的种子值，每镜头最多允许两个视频候选结果和一次条件计划修订。 每种方法仅访问自身生成的历史记录和当前可用的上传内容；不同故事之间的记忆会被重置。 调用次数包含失败的尝试，而完成状态则使用所有请求的镜头。 附录 E 详细说明了基线模型、预算范围及成本核算方式。

paragraphs.en: We presented REEL, a general-purpose planner that learns visual-memory management through a unified tool interface and reuses the same policy across video backends through adapters. REEL-SFT-4k and REEL-RL-1k support its training; REEL-Bench evaluates identity preservation and state changes under evolving requests and reference uploads. With JoyAI-Echo 1.5 and MiniMax-H3, REEL improves REEL-Bench Core-100 over DirectorAgent by 1.21 and 4.25 points, and ST-Bench cross-shot consistency over No Generated Memory by 15.1% and 20.7%, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 REEL，这是一种通用规划器，它通过统一的工具接口学习视觉记忆管理，并通过适配器在不同视频后端重复使用相同的策略。 REEL-SFT-4k 和 REEL-RL-1k 支持其训练；REEL-Bench 则在不断变化的请求和参考上传条件下评估身份保持与状态变化。 在使用 JoyAI-Echo 1.5 和 MiniMax-H3 时，REEL 在 REEL-Bench Core-100 上的得分分别比 DirectorAgent 高出 1.21 和 4.25 分，在 ST-Bench 跨镜头一致性方面则分别比 No Generated Memory 高出 15.1% 和 20.7%。

paragraphs.en: A source story contains an ordered list of shot requests and, when available, a schedule of reference uploads. The construction pipeline first records the original requests and their order. An inventory model identifies recurring subjects, objects, scenes, and styles, separating stable visual facts from mutable properties such as clothing, pose, weather, ownership, and object condition. Each inventory entry has an identifier and the first shot in which the entity appears. Each shot receives a separate analysis of its visual needs and intended state changes. The inventory prompt limits the entity list to 40 entries and requires one analysis per source shot. It does not prescribe a fixed cast, asset kit, or narrative structure.
paragraphs.zh: 源故事包含一个有序的拍摄请求列表，以及（如果有的话）参考素材上传的时间表。 构建流程首先记录原始请求及其顺序。 库存模型会识别重复出现的主题、物体、场景和风格，将稳定的视觉事实与可变属性（如服装、姿势、天气、所有权和物体状态）区分开来。 每个库存条目都有一个标识符，以及该实体首次出现的拍摄镜头。 每个拍摄镜头都会单独分析其视觉需求和预期的状态变化。 库存提示将实体列表限制在 40 个条目以内，并要求对源故事中的每个拍摄镜头进行一次分析。 它不会规定固定的演员阵容、资产库或叙事结构。

paragraphs.en: The optional diversification stage rewrites the presentation of a request while retaining its underlying event and explicit constraints. Its six prompt types are concise, cinematic, precise-opening, reference-guided, action-timing, and identity/state-focused requests. The supported language categories are English, Chinese, and mixed-language requests. The five interaction types are a new request, a continuation, reference constraints, reference followed by opening-frame creation, and revision of a previous request. A revision asks for an alternative depiction of the same event; it does not invent an observed generation failure or silently advance the story. The writer cannot insert tool names, expected action sequences, hidden quality labels, or future observations into user-facing text. An independent text review checks intent, identity, temporal information access, interaction grounding, and style before the requests enter collection. The prompts for writing and reviewing these requests appear in Appendix G.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 可选的多样化阶段会重写请求的呈现方式，同时保留其底层事件和明确约束。 它的六种提示类型包括简洁型、电影化型、精准开场型、参考引导型、动作时序型和身份/状态聚焦型请求。 支持的语言类别为英语、中文以及混合语言请求。 五种交互类型包括新请求、延续、参考约束、参考后创建开场画面，以及对先前请求的修订。 修订请求要求对同一事件进行替代性描述；它不会虚构观察到的生成失败，也不会悄无声息地推进故事。 作者不得在面向用户的文本中插入工具名称、预期的动作序列、隐藏的质量标签或未来的观察结果。 独立的文本审查会在请求进入收集阶段前，检查其意图、身份、时间信息访问、交互基础以及风格。 编写和审查这些请求的提示见附录 G.1。

paragraphs.en: The eight input profiles are text-only, identity reference, opening frame, complementary references, partial reference, redundant references, historical-state reference, and memory-only context. These profiles describe the evidence offered to the planner, rather than a required sequence of tool calls. A partial reference can supply useful identity information without specifying the entire scene. A historical-state reference depicts a genuinely established earlier state and is described as such. A text-only request has no new uploaded image, but may still have useful memory from earlier generated shots. These construction categories are not quality labels and are not exposed as answers to the planner.
paragraphs.zh: 八种输入配置文件分别为：纯文本、身份参考、初始帧、互补参考、部分参考、冗余参考、历史状态参考和仅记忆上下文。 这些配置文件描述了提供给规划器的证据，而非必须遵循的工具调用序列。 部分参考可以在不指定整个场景的情况下提供有用的身份信息。 历史状态参考描绘了一个确实已建立的先前状态，并明确以这种方式进行描述。 纯文本请求没有新上传的图像，但仍可能包含先前生成画面中的有用记忆信息。 这些构建类别并非质量标签，也不会作为答案提供给规划器。

paragraphs.en: For each shot, the upload planner receives its original request, the relevant inventory entries, and available preceding reference images. It proposes individual images with a purpose, entity associations, reference dependencies, a user-facing description, a complete image-generation prompt, and an aspect ratio. Purposes include identity, scene, object, state, interaction, opening, and style. The planner deliberately leaves some requirements unsupported so that online retrieval or reference creation remains useful. It does not generate a complete canonical asset library for every entity by default. When a previously established identity lacks a reliable visual reference, the planner records the missing dependency instead of independently inventing a new appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次拍摄，上传规划器会收到原始请求、相关的库存条目以及可用的先前参考图像。 它会提出单张图像，其中包含用途、实体关联、参考依赖关系、面向用户的描述、完整的图像生成提示词以及宽高比。 用途包括身份、场景、物体、状态、互动、开场和风格。 规划器会刻意保留一些未满足的需求，以确保在线检索或参考创建仍然有用。 默认情况下，它不会为每个实体生成完整的标准资产库。 当先前已建立的身份缺乏可靠的视觉参考时，规划器会记录缺失的依赖关系，而不是独立地创造新的外观。

paragraphs.en: The image provider executes each planned prompt using its specified preceding images. The checker receives the resulting image, its intended purpose, the user-facing description, the current request, and the actual reference images. It checks identity preservation, requirement preservation, and usability for the stated purpose from pixels, rather than treating the generation prompt as evidence of success. A partial or deliberately redundant image is judged against its limited purpose. Failed checks can produce a corrected prompt for a bounded repair attempt. Images with unresolved identity drift, misleading descriptions, or incompatible content do not become valid uploads. The system prompts for inventory analysis, upload planning, and image checking are reproduced in Appendix G.2 . Provider names inside these verbatim prompts identify the corresponding collection implementation, rather than all image backends supported by REEL.

paragraphs.en: Each shot starts a fresh planner conversation with the immutable current request. The execution environment carries forward the committed memory bank, subject registry, and accepted previous-shot context. The planner first reads the registry, completing pagination before using other tools. Retrieved metadata identifies candidate evidence; a separate visual inspection authorizes the exact representation before it can condition image creation or video generation. Table 4 summarizes the interface.
paragraphs.zh: 每次执行都会基于不可更改的当前请求，启动一次全新的规划器对话。 执行环境会保留已提交的内存库、主题注册表以及之前执行中已接受的相关上下文信息。 规划器首先读取注册表，在完成分页处理后再使用其他工具。 检索到的元数据会识别出候选证据；通过独立的视觉检查批准其精确表现形式后，才能以此作为条件生成图像或视频。 表 4 总结了该接口的整体情况。

paragraphs.en: The planner authors a self-contained generation_prompt and a ranked list of semantic bindings. A binding identifies an observed representation, its subjects, the requirements it supports, and its intended effect. An identity reference supplies stable appearance, whereas an exact-opening reference specifies the desired initial pose and composition. The same physical representation is not duplicated to occupy multiple bindings. The adapter performs backend-specific prompt enhancement and condition allocation, then records which conditions were actually applied. This separates the planner’s backend-agnostic enhanced prompt from the adapter’s backend-specific enhancement.

paragraphs.en: The runtime distinguishes reference suitability, generated-video review, and eligibility for durable memory. Video review checks request and reference adherence, observable action and continuity, and visible defects using the returned checklist. The planner assesses the checklist returned for the current purpose rather than substituting a generic aesthetic rating. An allowed repair must change the evidence, its semantic use, the complete prompt, or a combination of these in response to an observed problem. A resample preserves the effective prompt and conditions and requests a different host-controlled random seed. Both preserve the original request and requirement identifiers and consume the corresponding remaining budget. Changing only a candidate identifier or rationale does not constitute a repair. The only terminal action is finish_memory_session ; pending generation and unresolved candidate obligations cannot be reported as completed shots. The earlier evidence-only interface permits additional video generation only with a previously unused reference-condition configuration; prompt changes alone do not request another sample in that mode. The joint prompt-authoring interface used by the exported SFT prompt instead exposes the explicit repair and resample contracts above. Original user assets remain unchanged in either mode.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时区分参考适用性、生成视频审核以及持久内存的资格。 视频审核通过返回的检查清单，检查请求和参考的合规性、可观察的动作与连续性，以及可见的缺陷。 规划器评估为当前目的返回的检查清单，而不是用通用的美学评分取而代之。 允许的修复必须针对观察到的问题，改变证据、其语义用途、完整的提示，或这些要素的组合。 重新采样会保留有效的提示和条件，并请求一个由主机控制的随机种子。 两种模式都保留原始请求和要求标识符，并消耗相应的剩余预算。 仅更改候选标识符或理由不构成修复。 唯一的终端动作是 finish_memory_session；待处理的生成和未解决的候选义务不能报告为已完成的操作。 早期的仅证据接口仅允许在先前未使用的参考条件配置下生成额外视频；仅更改提示不会在该模式下请求另一个样本。 导出 SFT 提示所使用的联合提示编写接口，则明确暴露了上述修复和重新采样协议。 原始用户资产在任何一种模式下均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Writeback stores stable, reusable evidence with subject associations, provenance, and temporal state. It excludes speculative attributes, failed candidates, draft prompts, and transient actions. The planner can retain older-state evidence while recording its temporal role instead of overwriting the canonical identity. A previous-shot tail already supplied by the host need not be copied into long-term memory solely for adjacent-shot continuity. An explicit no-update decision is valid when the shot contributes no useful durable evidence.
paragraphs.zh: Writeback 存储具有主体关联、来源和临时状态的稳定、可重用的证据。 它排除推测性属性、失败的候选项、提示草案和临时动作。 规划器可以在记录旧状态证据的同时保留其时间角色，而不是覆盖标准身份。 主机已提供的先前示例尾部无需仅为相邻示例的连续性而复制到长期记忆中。 当该示例未提供任何有用的持久性证据时，明确决定不更新是合理的。

paragraphs.en: Filtering operates at three boundaries. Input checks validate shot sequences, upload dependencies, asset availability, and truthful descriptions. Execution checks validate native tool-call arguments, tool-result correspondence, authorized representations, legal state transitions, resolved candidate groups, and completion receipts. Export checks validate the trajectory and multimodal conversation, preserve tool schemas and source associations, and verify referenced media. The SFT exporter admits accepted shots from an incomplete story only when those shots have their own completed execution records; an unfinished later shot is not converted into a successful trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 过滤操作在三个边界处执行。 输入检查用于验证拍摄序列、上传依赖项、资源可用性以及真实描述。 执行检查用于验证原生工具调用参数、工具结果对应关系、授权表示、合法的状态转换、已解析的候选组以及完成确认。 导出检查用于验证轨迹和多模态对话，保留工具模式和源关联，并核实所引用的媒体内容。 SFT 导出器仅当不完整故事中的某个拍摄片段拥有其自身的已完成执行记录时，才会接受该片段；未完成的后继拍摄片段不会被转换为成功的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: The exported conversation contains system instructions, the original request, planner tool calls, and the observations available before each subsequent decision. Supervision applies to planner-generated action tokens. Requests, tool outputs, and visual inputs are conditioning context; teacher reasoning and adapter-internal prompt enhancement are not action targets. The training export replaces the collection system prompt with the joint prompt-authoring and memory-planning prompt, while retaining the native tool schema and executed actions. Both prompts are reproduced in Appendix G.3 so that this transformation is explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 导出的对话包含系统指令、原始请求、规划器工具调用，以及每次后续决策前可用的观察信息。 监督机制适用于规划器生成的动作令牌。 请求、工具输出和视觉输入属于条件上下文；教师推理和适配器内部的提示增强不属于动作目标。 训练导出过程会用联合提示编写与记忆规划提示替换集合系统提示，同时保留原始工具模式和已执行的动作。 两个提示均在附录 G.3 中重新呈现，以便明确展示这一转换过程。

paragraphs.en: For online learning, a single-shot task contains a request and its initial resource state rather than a prescribed teacher action sequence. A multi-shot task groups consecutive requests and propagates the policy’s own committed resources across them. The following shot is therefore affected by the evidence that the policy actually retained, not by a reset to teacher-produced memory. Infrastructure failures and judge transport errors are recorded separately from content-quality failures.
paragraphs.zh: 对于在线学习，单次任务包含一个请求及其初始资源状态，而不是预设的教师动作序列。 多次任务会将连续的请求分组，并将策略自身已分配的资源在这些请求间传递。 因此，后续任务会受到策略实际保留的证据的影响，而不是由教师生成的记忆重置所影响。 基础设施故障和传输错误与内容质量故障分开记录。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 describes the snapshot used by the completed SFT checkpoint. One trajectory record is one accepted shot-level tool-use conversation, not one source story or one tool call. paragraphs.en: The benchmark selection uses seed 20260922 and a fixed manifest. All compared methods receive the same raw requests and scheduled uploads. Each method builds memory only from its own preceding outputs; it cannot access another method’s generated images or future shots. Beyond identifier matching, we checked story semantics and reference content against the training data and performed content-level deduplication.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试的选择使用了种子值 20260922 和一个固定的清单。 所有被比较的方法都接收相同的原始请求和计划好的上传任务。 每种方法仅基于自身的前序输出构建记忆；它无法访问其他方法生成的图像或未来的拍摄内容。 对 300 个基准测试案例与每个 SFT 部分进行的精确故事标识符比较发现，与训练集（4,142 个故事）、验证集（226 个）和测试集（232 个）均无共享的标识符。 除了标识符匹配之外，我们还检查了故事语义和参考内容是否与训练数据一致，并进行了内容级别的去重处理。

paragraphs.en: The builder serializes each ordered request sequence as UTF-8 JSON and hashes it with SHA-256; the selected benchmark contains 300 distinct sequence hashes. This check identifies exact repeated request sequences within the benchmark, separately from the content-level training-data check. paragraphs.en: Each applicable dimension receives an integer from zero to four: 0 denotes absence, unusability, or direct contradiction; 1 denotes predominantly major failures; 2 denotes partial success with important failures; 3 denotes mostly successful execution with localized issues; and 4 denotes success without a material issue in the supplied evidence. The evaluator multiplies these ratings by 25 to obtain the 0–100 scale. Every numeric score requires a concise reason and at least one valid generated-frame citation. Only reference fidelity and state compliance permit a null rating, with a nonempty explanation of non-applicability. An expected subject that is absent, or an intended state change that fails to occur, is a failure rather than a reason to omit the dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 每个适用的维度都会获得一个从 0 到 4 的整数：0 表示不存在、不可用或直接矛盾；1 表示主要存在重大失败；2 表示部分成功但存在重要失败；3 表示执行基本成功但存在局部问题；4 表示在所提供的证据中未出现实质性问题的成功。 评估者将这些评分乘以 25，从而得到 0–100 的评分范围。 每个数值评分都必须附带一个简洁的理由以及至少一条有效的生成框架引用。 只有当涉及保真度和状态合规性时，才允许使用空值评分，但必须提供非空的不可适用性说明。 如果预期的主体不存在，或预期的状态变化未能发生，这属于失败，而非省略该维度的理由。

paragraphs.en: Reported quality scores include only stories whose entire requested shot sequence completes with valid, decodable videos. Completion refers to execution status rather than a quality-score threshold. Failed, blocked, and incomplete stories are excluded from quality averages, without zero-score imputation or completion-fraction penalties. Their generation outcomes still contribute to completion statistics over the full attempted set. Unresolved jobs remain unresolved; a transport timeout alone is not evidence that a generated video is poor. Missing or invalid judge responses invalidate the applicable aggregate and are retried without assigning fabricated quality scores. Judgments are validated for exact metric keys, integer ranges, non-applicability explanations, and cited frame indices. Cached valid judgments are reused; retries repair missing or malformed responses rather than selecting a favorable rating. Reference/state applicability and the fixed-weight Core-100 aggregation are specified in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 报告的质量分数仅包含其全部请求的镜头序列均以有效且可解码的视频完成的故事情节。 “完成”指的是执行状态，而非质量分数的阈值。 失败、受阻和不完整的故事情节不会被纳入质量平均值计算，也不会进行零分推算或按完成比例进行惩罚。 它们的生成结果仍会对整个尝试集合中的完成统计数据产生贡献。 未解决的任务保持未解决状态；仅凭传输超时并不能证明生成的视频质量差。 缺失或无效的评审员响应会使相应的汇总结果无效，并将重新尝试，而不会分配虚构的质量分数。 评审结果会依据精确的指标键、整数范围、不适用性说明以及引用的帧索引进行验证。 已缓存的有效评审结果会被重复使用；重试会修复缺失或格式错误的响应，而非选择有利的评分。 参考/状态适用性以及固定权重的 Core-100 汇总方法在附录 D 中有详细说明。

sents.en: Failed, blocked, and incomplete stories are excluded from quality averages, without zero-score imputation or completion-fraction penalties.
sents.zh: 失败、受阻和不完整的故事情节不会被纳入质量平均值计算，也不会进行零分推算或按完成比例进行惩罚。

sents.en: Unresolved jobs remain unresolved; a transport timeout alone is not evidence that a generated video is poor.
sents.zh: 未解决的任务保持未解决状态；仅凭传输超时并不能证明生成的视频质量差。

sents.en: Missing or invalid judge responses invalidate the applicable aggregate and are retried without assigning fabricated quality scores.

sents.en: Cached valid judgments are reused; retries repair missing or malformed responses rather than selecting a favorable rating.

paragraphs.en: Reference fidelity is applicable when a shot request has relevant uploaded image references available at that point in the story. A story-level reference-fidelity score averages the applicable shot scores; the dimension is not applicable to a story with no applicable reference comparisons. State compliance is applicable when the requests specify a testable change in appearance, object state, or environment state. A requested change that is not realized receives a low score rather than being declared not applicable. The applicability decisions select a profile before its weighted score is calculated; neither method identity nor the resulting ranking selects the weights. Applicability is determined from the frozen requests and available uploads and held fixed across methods.

paragraphs.en: The REEL-Bench main results, training-stage and memory-mechanism ablations, training-budget control, and full REEL transfer to unseen backends use the frozen set of 300 stories and 2,700 requested shots (Table 9 ). The matched-adapter checkpoint comparison in Table 13 instead uses a fixed 30-story subset containing 263 requested shots. Each run processes the full request sequence and preserves the original upload schedule. These counts describe attempted coverage; reported quality uses only successfully completed stories, so the scored-story count can differ by method. paragraphs.en: The controlled baseline implementation keeps user uploads distinct from generated memory. Newly arriving uploads are prioritized before historical references, duplicate images are removed, and the remaining condition budget determines how many historical images can be used. Declared voice references retain their arrived matching character image and their speaker association. Within a backend, all methods receive the same raw requests, upload schedule, generation configuration, and first-attempt video seed. Backend adaptation is shared; the REEL planner can additionally author a complete enhanced prompt and create references.
paragraphs.zh: 受控基线实现将用户上传内容与生成的记忆区分开来。 新到达的上传内容会优先于历史参考处理，重复图像会被移除，而剩余的预算则决定可以使用的历史图像数量。 已声明的语音参考会保留其匹配的角色图像以及与其说话者的关联。 在同一个后端系统中，所有方法都会接收到相同的原始请求、上传计划、生成配置以及首次尝试的视频种子。 后端的适配机制是共享的；REEL 规划器还可以额外编写完整的增强提示词并创建参考内容。

paragraphs.en: This method can use references uploaded by the user up to the current shot, including earlier uploads, but never references extracted from previously generated clips. It does not receive a generated previous-shot tail as a hidden continuity condition. When no user reference is available, the request is submitted without a visual reference. The baseline therefore removes generated memory, rather than removing the user’s provided conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 此方法可以使用用户截至当前轮次上传的参考材料，包括早期上传的材料，但绝不会使用从先前生成的片段中提取的参考材料。 它不会将先前轮次生成的后续内容作为隐式连续性条件接收。 当没有可用的用户参考材料时，请求将不带视觉参考材料提交。 因此，基线模型会移除生成的记忆，而不是移除用户提供的条件。

paragraphs.en: Recent Memory, CLIP-based Retrieval, and StoryMem-style Memory use the same generated-keyframe pool within each method’s own story. The extractor considers every decoded frame, retains frames with a LAION aesthetic prediction of at least 5.0 on the raw 1–10 scale, and selects at most three frames per shot using normalized CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings. Starting from a cosine-similarity threshold of 0.90, it scans eligible frames chronologically and accepts a new frame when its similarity to the last selected frame falls below the threshold. If more than three survive, it reduces the threshold in increments of 0.01 and repeats the selection. This shared extractor separates admission quality and diversity from the subsequent memory-selection rule.
paragraphs.zh: Recent Memory、CLIP-based Retrieval 和 StoryMem-style Memory 在各自方法的故事中都使用相同的生成关键帧池。 提取器会检查每个解码后的帧，保留 LAION 美学预测值在原始 1–10 量表上至少为 5.0 的帧，并使用归一化的 CLIP ViT-L/14 嵌入按每镜头最多选择三帧。 从余弦相似度阈值 0.90 开始，它按时间顺序扫描符合条件的帧，并在新帧与最后选中的帧的相似度低于该阈值时接受该新帧。 如果保留的帧超过三帧，它会以 0.01 的增量降低阈值并重复选择过程。 这种共享的提取器将准入质量和多样性与后续的记忆选择规则分离开来。

paragraphs.en: The rule protects the earliest three stored candidates and fills the remaining budget with recent candidates. This is a memory-selection adaptation to the common backend, not a rerun of StoryMem’s original generator or its complete original quality-filtering configuration ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: The current request is encoded with the same CLIP model as the stored keyframes. To avoid silently discarding the end of a long request, its tokens are split into blocks of at most 75 content tokens, with start/end tokens added to each block. The normalized block embeddings are averaged and renormalized. Historical frames are ranked by cosine similarity to this request vector, with stable history-order tie breaking, and the highest-ranked frames fill the available slots.
paragraphs.zh: 当前请求使用与已存储的关键帧相同的 CLIP 模型进行编码。 为避免长请求的末尾被静默丢弃，其词元会被分割为最多包含 75 个内容词元的块，并为每个块添加起始/结束词元。 对归一化后的块嵌入向量求平均并重新归一化。 历史帧根据与当前请求向量的余弦相似度进行排序，在相似度相同时保持历史顺序稳定，排名最高的帧将填充可用槽位。

sents.en: Changing worker concurrency changes scheduling, not the frozen request sequence, seed, or eligible history.
sents.zh: 更改工作进程并发性会改变调度安排，但不会改变已冻结的请求序列、种子或可用历史。

sents.en: An accepted remote generation is resumed using its existing job identity rather than replaced with an unrecorded new sample.
sents.zh: 已接受的远程生成将使用其现有的作业身份继续执行，而不是被替换为未记录的新样本。

paragraphs.en: The VLM teacher produces SFT demonstrations; the quantitative and qualitative REEL results use the full trained planner without teacher fallback. SFT-only and single-shot-GRPO checkpoints appear only in explicitly labeled training-stage comparisons. Matching video-candidate caps does not equalize total computation: REEL can incur extra reference-image generation, planner, inspection, and adaptation calls. Cost reporting therefore separates video calls, image creation/editing calls, planner calls, completed shots, and end-to-end latency, including failed attempts. The four-row qualitative comparison does not contain No Generated Memory or DirectorAgent and cannot establish a ranking against those methods.
paragraphs.zh: VLM 教师生成 SFT 演示；定量和定性的 REEL 结果使用完整的训练规划器，而不会回退到教师模型。 仅使用 SFT 和单次 GRPO 的检查点仅出现在明确标注的训练阶段比较中。 匹配视频候选上限并不会使总计算量相等：REEL 可能会产生额外的参考图像生成、规划器、检查和自适应调用。 因此，成本报告将视频调用、图像创建/编辑调用、规划器调用、已完成镜头以及端到端延迟（包括失败尝试）分开报告。 四行定性的比较不包含“无生成记忆”或“DirectorAgent”，因此无法与这些方法进行排名比较。

paragraphs.en: The completed SFT run initializes Qwen3.5-9B and processes the effective 33,088-example training set for one epoch, reaching 1,034 optimizer steps. Table 11 records its configuration. paragraphs.en: Single-shot GRPO samples alternative tool trajectories from the same request and initial resources, and uses the protocol, trajectory, and video-quality reward components defined in Section 3.3 . Multi-shot GRPO propagates policy-produced memory through consecutive requests and adds episode-level memory utility, allowing later-shot outcomes to affect earlier planning decisions. Only planner-generated tokens enter the policy objective; the generator and adapter remain outside policy optimization. Single-shot GRPO initializes from the SFT checkpoint, and multi-shot GRPO continues from the resulting single-shot checkpoint. The main REEL comparisons use the checkpoint after this three-stage sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 单次 GRPO 从同一请求和初始资源中采样替代工具轨迹，并使用第 3.3 节中定义的协议、轨迹和视频质量奖励组件。 多次 GRPO 将策略生成的记忆通过连续请求传递，并增加回合级记忆效用，使后续步骤的结果能够影响早期的规划决策。 只有规划器生成的标记会进入策略目标；生成器和适配器则保持在策略优化之外。 单次 GRPO 从 SFT 检查点初始化，而多次 GRPO 则从由此产生的单次检查点继续训练。 主要的 REEL 比较使用此三阶段序列后的检查点。

paragraphs.en: Training-stage ablations compare base, SFT-only, single-shot-GRPO, and full checkpoints on the same input set. Memory-mechanism ablations hold the checkpoint fixed while disabling retrieval, creation, or review individually. The retrieval ablation preserves user uploads and preceding-shot context. The review ablation accepts the initial video without candidate assessment or condition-plan revision; it retains the same maximum resource caps as full REEL. Unseen-backend transfer changes the adapter and generator while keeping the planner fixed; these backends are absent from its training rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 训练阶段的消融实验在相同输入集上比较了基础模型、仅 SFT、单样本 GRPO 和完整检查点。 记忆机制的消融实验在保持检查点不变的同时，分别禁用检索、创建或审查功能。 检索消融实验保留了用户上传的内容以及前序示例的上下文信息。 审查消融实验在接受初始视频时不进行候选评估或条件计划修订；其最大资源限制与完整 REEL 保持一致。 未见过的后端迁移会改变适配器和生成器，但保持规划器不变；这些后端并未出现在其训练过程中的推理流程中。

paragraphs.en: Table 13 reports a checkpoint comparison on Seedance 2.0 and Kling 3.0 using SFT, single-shot GRPO, and full REEL. Within each backend, the adapter revision, planner prompt, tool schemas, image-generation services, video settings, and per-shot resource caps remain fixed; only the planner checkpoint changes. Each variant receives the same fixed REEL-Bench subset of 30 stories and 263 requested shots, without target-backend training or teacher fallback. This subset comparison is separate from the full-benchmark transfer results in Table 3(c) . Quality uses the common set of fully completed, validly scored stories across all three variants, with its story and shot counts reported explicitly. The matched sets contain 16 stories and 132 shots for Seedance 2.0, and 18 stories and 150 shots for Kling 3.0. On these sets, REEL improves Story over SFT by 4.85 and 3.22 points, respectively. Completion uses all 263 requested shots, including successful shots in incomplete stories. It is reported on a 0–1 scale, rounded to two decimal places. Paired Story differences are measured against SFT on this common set; their 95% intervals use 2,000 story-bootstrap resamples with seed 20260922. Actual planner, image, video, and inspection calls and end-to-end time are recorded separately; equal resource caps do not imply equal realized cost.

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 documents a failure in Shot 2 of The Clockwork Skyfall with MiniMax-H3 and the full REEL checkpoint. The recorded visual review found suspension lines and decorative stars already present in the created reference image. The compiled prompt then described “five hanging star ornaments” and applied that image as an exact opening frame, although the requested event involved falling objects. The error therefore entered before video synthesis and was reinforced by the conditioning decision. This example illustrates why inspecting a reference is not sufficient unless the assessment correctly separates stable identity, temporary arrangement, and the requested action. The observation concerns the inspected reference and fixed sampled video frames, not a full-video motion or audio evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 图9记录了《机械天坠》第2次拍摄中，使用MiniMax-H3和完整REEL检查点时出现的故障。 记录下来的视觉审查发现，生成的参考图像中已经存在悬挂线和装饰性星星。 随后编译的提示词描述了“五个悬挂的星形装饰品”，并将该图像作为精确的起始帧应用，尽管所请求的事件涉及物体坠落。 因此，这个错误发生在视频合成之前，并且被条件设定决策进一步强化。 这个例子说明了为何仅检查参考图像是不够的，除非评估能够正确区分稳定的身份特征、临时排列以及所请求的动作。 这一观察涉及被检查的参考图像和固定的采样视频帧，而非对完整视频的动态或音频进行评估。

sents.en: The completion fraction mentioned in the generic judge prompts is one for every story included in the reported quality scores.
sents.zh: 通用评判提示中提到的完成比例是：每包含在报告的质量分数中的每一个故事计为一次。

sents.en: Thus the judge does not choose weights or see a method ranking when assigning the component scores.
sents.zh: 因此，在分配各部分分数时，评判者不会选择权重，也不会看到方法排名。
